email.subject: Quick fix for Honey Hair Studio's site
email.body:
Hi Omar,

I checked Honey Hair Studio's website. Two things are likely costing you bookings: it isn't mobile-friendly, so most people searching for a salon on their phone have a hard time even viewing it, and there's no online booking, so anyone wanting to grab a slot after hours has to wait and call you back. The site also doesn't list your hours, which adds to the confusion.

I fix exactly this kind of thing for a flat fee. Want a free 10-minute walkthrough where I show you what's happening and how I'd fix it? No obligation.

Alex
Northlight Web
